# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Compliance — Code

> 4 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Compliance under Code. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Code

- [Artifacts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/code/artifacts.md): List Claude Code Artifacts owned by organizations under the parent organization.
- [Delete Code Artifact](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/code/artifacts/delete.md): Permanently deletes a Code Artifact and all its versions. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.
- [Download Code Artifact Version Content](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/code/artifacts/retrieve_version.md): Streams the content of one version of a Claude Code Artifact as the response body.
- [List Code Artifacts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance/code/artifacts/list.md): List Claude Code Artifacts owned by organizations under the parent organization.
